paite: Aw TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu hilh un; amah ahoih ngal a; azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding hi.
heading: BU NGANA / (Sam 107-150) / Pathian hoihna phatna

paite: TOUPA tatsate'n huai gen uhen, doumi khut a kipan atatkhiakte'n.
Gam teng a kipan apikhawm a, suahlam leh tumlam, simlam leh mallam a kipan in.
Gamdai a gamkeu lampi ah avakvak ua; tenna ding khua himhim amu kei uhi.
Gilkial leh dangtak in ahinna uh agilsung uah abahta hi.
Huaitak in abuaina uah TOUPA asam ua, ama'n alungkhamna uah ahumbit hi.
Mihing tenna khua a apaitheihna ding un, lampi tangtak ah apikheta hi.
Aw, mihingte'n TOUPA azahngaihna ziak leh mihing tate tung a athillamdang hihte ziak in phat teitei le u aw!
Ama'n ahinna un alunggulh mahmah in ataisak a, hinna gilkial avahsak hi.
Mial nuai ah leh sihna lim a tu a, gimthuakna leh sikkhau a hente mahmah;
Pathian thute tung ah ahel ua, Tungnungpen lunggel angaihneu ziak un.
Ama'n alungtang uh sepgimna in aminsakta a; apuk ua, panpihpa ding himhim a-om ngal kei a.
Abuaina uah TOUPA asam ua, ama'n abuaina ua kipan apikhia a, amangbatna ua pan ahondam hi.
Mial nuai a kipan leh sihna lim a kipan apikhia a, ahenna uh asuktatsakta hi.
Aw, mihingte'n TOUPA azahngaihna ziak in leh mihing tate tung a athillamdang hihte ziak in phat teitei le u aw!
Ama'n dal kongkhakte achimsak a, akalhna siktawnte ahihtanta ngal a.
Mihaite atatlekna ziak un leh, agitlouh satlouhnate uh ziak in akihihgim uhi.
Ahinna un nek theih chiteng akih a; sihna kulh kongkhakte anaih uhi.
Huaitak in abuaina uah TOUPA asam ua, ama'n amangbatna ua kipan in ahondam zel hi.
Athu asawlkhia a, amau adamsak hi, amanthatna ua kipan in ahumbit hi.
Aw, mihingte'n TOUPA achit ziak leh mihing tate tung a athillamdang hihte ziak in phat teitei le uh aw!
Amau kipahthugen kithoihnate lan uhenla, athilhihte uh la sa in hilh uhen.
Tuipi a long lian apaisuk a, tui zatak tung a nasemte'n.
Huaite'n TOUPA thilhihte leh tui thupi a athillamdang hihte amu uhi.
Ama'n thu apia a, huihpi anungsak a, huai in atuikihotte asangsak hi.
Van lam ah septouh in a-om ua, tui thukpi ah atumsuk nawn zel uhi; mangbatna ziak in ahinna uh azulbei hi.
Zukham bang in asawi hoihoi ua, atuan loklok ua, omdan ding hun lel athei kei nak uhi.
Huan abuaina uah TOUPA asam ua, ama'n amangbatna ua kipan in api hi.
Huihpi adaisak duam a, huchi in atuikihotte adai uhi.
Huan adaih tak ziak in akipak ua; huchi in ama'n a-omna ding uh longkhawlna ah apitung hi.
Aw, mihingte'n TOUPA achit ziak leh, mihing tate tung a athillamdang hihte ziak in phat mahmah le uh aw!
Amau mite kikhopna ah amah phat uhenla, upate tutna ah phat uhen.
Ama'n luipite gamdai asuaksak a, tui nakte leng lei keu asuaksak hi.
Gam hoih gamsia asuaksak zel, asung a omte genhak ziak in.
Gamdai dilmun asuaksak zel a, gamkeu leng tui nak asuaksak hi.
Huai ah gilkialte a-omsak a, tenna ding khua abawl uhi.
Loute anei ua, grephuante abawl ua, agah hong pungte amuhtheihna ding un.
Amau avualzawl a, nakpitak a hihpun in a-om ua; agante uh kiam aphal kei hi.
Huan nuaisiah, gimthuakna, lungkhamna ziak in akiam hiaihiai ua, akun ngiungiau lel uhi.
Ama'n miliante tung ah muhsitna asungbua a, gamdai, lampi omlouhna ah avakvaisak hi.
Himahleh gentheite gimthuakna a kipan in mun sang ah akhatou hi, ganhon bang in inkuanpihte asiamsak hi.
Midiktatte'n huai mu in akipak ding uh; thulimlouhna tengteng in akam ahum ding hi.
Kuapeuh apil in huaite akemhoih ding ua, TOUPA zahngaihnate angaihtuah ding uhi.
